description: A server that stores messages between a producer and a consumer so they do not need to be online together.
A messaging model where each message goes to one consumer and is removed after it is acknowledged.
A model such as a Kafka topic where messages are retained and each consumer group tracks its own offset.
A model where a producer publishes an event and any number of independent subscribers react to it.
A guarantee that a message is never lost but may be delivered more than once.
A handler that leaves the same result whether it processes a message once or several times.
